scope: Fresh eighteen-episode teacher collection on nine train cases only. Fit two shared ankle laws, each with a fitted clipped-pitch waist coupling; no teacher gains copied. Compare five fixed representations/channel/output-range variants across three frozen parents on 27 train-family selection conditions per variant. Select globally by fewer falls, longer survival, lower RMSE, then fewer active coefficients before any final canonical/audit run. Final selected policies each run nine canonical and nine separate training-family audit conditions; privileged teacher runs the nine unique canonical and 27 audit conditions once. All transitions retained, no final-data fitting, release qualification, model-based/PPO efficiency or hardware authority.
